$schema: Each case: {name, fixture, criteria: [{name, description}], expected: {passed, must_fail_criteria: [...]}}. Runner: loads the report markdown, asks LLMJudge to score against the criteria, compares against expected. `must_fail_criteria` is a list of criterion-names that the judge MUST mark `met=false` — covers cases where we know specific failures must surface.

criteria.name: has_overall_severity
criteria.description: Report contains a line of the form '**Overall severity:** <bucket>' near the top.

criteria.name: mentions_all_roles
criteria.description: All three reviewer sections are present with H3 headers: '### Dependencies', '### Injection', '### OWASP Top 10'.

criteria.name: no_fake_cve_format
criteria.description: Any CVE id mentioned uses the canonical CVE-YYYY-NNNN format (4-digit year + 4-7 digit serial). Placeholder shapes like 'CVE-XXXX-XXXX' are NOT acceptable.

criteria.name: exploit_has_disclaimer
criteria.description: If an 'Exploit proposals' section exists, it MUST open with a 'Defensive use only' disclaimer that warns against targeting third-party systems and includes the words 'isolated environment' or 'own code'. If no exploit section exists, this criterion is automatically met.

criteria.name: no_raw_json_in_body
criteria.description: Each reviewer section's body is prose or Markdown bullets. Raw `{...}` JSON dumps in section bodies are NOT acceptable — JSON is for tool output, not for the human-facing report.
